result.topic_en: A list of the prime numbers up to 103, with the primes 11, 29 and 97 marked by the fractions 4/11, 6/29 and 8/97.

methods.what: List of the primes (with 1 included) up to 103

Fraction notes written below the primes 11, 29 and 97, pairing them with 4, 6 and 8. These numbers coincide with the first prime gaps of size 4 (7 to 11), 6 (23 to 29) and 8 (89 to 97), but the page does not state this.
